_description: P2S benchmark v2. 70 labelled citizen messages. 'expected' is the correct domain (null when the right behaviour is to ask or to raise an alarm). 'acceptable' lists other domains that are defensible for genuinely borderline cases. 'status' is the correct system behaviour: resolved | needs_clarification | emergency. 'layer' for emergencies: 1 = a rule-based keyword guardrail should catch it, 2 = only semantic understanding can catch it. Labels were written before any model was run; layer-1 rules were refined while writing this file, so layer-1 recall is an upper bound and layer-2 is the honest measure.
